_comment: Wakes the hub builds (app/services/wake_digest.py), with what the app's wake parser should find in each. Written by fastapi-backend/tests/test_wake_digest_contract.py, which fails when a wake changes; read by mycelium-frontend/src/lib/wake-digest.test.ts, which parses every sample. To write it again after changing the wake: MYCELIUM_WRITE_CONTRACTS=1 uv run pytest tests/test_wake_digest_contract.py
